requirementSource: GitHub issue #265, security/tenant-isolation lane: Cross-tenant payroll/export denial. Draft PR #378 explicitly covers employee and manager role denial but excludes cross-tenant payroll-admin isolation.

implementation: Added a bounded read-only GET probe for the existing /api/payroll-export/{batchId} route. It rejects same-tenant or malformed scope before network access, disables redirects, requires HTTP 403/404, exact source headers, and absence of CSV/download headers. It accepts a caller-supplied authenticated request context, so it creates no session, release, export writer, runner, or deployment.

remainingRisks: The caller must independently establish the actor's current tenant and payroll-admin role, and the released batch's different tenant, from authenticated durable readback.
The injected request context must be the actor's real hosted browser session; a synthetic fake cannot establish isolation.
A denial status and absent CSV headers do not alone prove that no sensitive response body leaked; the canonical owner must inspect the actual hosted body and audit trail.
The serving SHA and private access are not independently verified by this package.
